name: Maverick Helicopter
summary: The reliable twin-engine utility and passenger helicopter of Vice City, offering swift aerial transport across the Leonida archipelago.
description: Seen patrolling the skies above downtown skyscrapers and offshore yachts, the Maverick remains the most accessible and versatile helicopter in GTA VI. Accommodating up to four passengers with high-altitude stability.

seo.title: Maverick Helicopter: Specs, Locations & Flight Guide
seo.description: Comprehensive guide to the Maverick helicopter in GTA VI. Flight handling, passenger capacity, rooftop helipad spawns, and police variants.
